records.title: Pressa idraulica
records.assumptionsAndDomain: Incompressible volume balance; ideal press force gain4 and reciprocal stroke; losses/height corrections excluded for force/work claim.
records.manualProcedure: Divide stroke by4; multiply back by4 to check.
records.adversarialInterpretation: At zero stroke output0; no negative stroke in control domain.

records.title: Trasmissione dell’incremento di pressione in un liquido confinato
records.assumptionsAndDomain: Static confined liquid; unchanged density and depth. Added pressure is transmitted without attenuation, while original hydrostatic baseline remains.
records.manualProcedure: Add the two pressure increments in the same kPa unit.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Differentiate total relative pressure from only the increment; zero addition still leaves20kPa.

records.assumptionsAndDomain: Object immersed without bottom contact. Working10N/L is explicitly approximate rather than universal exact SI gravity.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Buoyancy increases with displaced volume, not object material; zero immersed volume gives0.

records.adversarialInterpretation: Do not divide by2: given velocity is already section mean. Zero velocity gives zero flow.

records.adversarialInterpretation: Conservation applies to mass; volume equality requires same density, supplied by same liquid model.

records.title: Equazione di continuità
records.assumptionsAndDomain: Steady incompressible flow; positive local cross-sectional area. Control area1..8cm2 excludes singular zero.
records.manualProcedure: Divide24 by section area; check multiplication A*v returns24.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Area doubling halves speed; no claim about pressure without an energy model.

records.title: Velocità media di sezione
records.independentDerivation: IF circular Newtonian fully-developed no-slip Poiseuille profile v(r)=vmax(1-r2/R2), area average gives vmean=vmax/2
records.assumptionsAndDomain: Laminar alone does not uniquely establish this factor. Full source/profile must supply circular parabolic assumptions; primary result is conditional.
records.manualProcedure: Integrate annuli: (2/R2) integral_0^R vmax(1-r2/R2)r dr=vmax/2. Divide supplied axis speed by2 only under this profile.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Uniform plug profile is a counterexample to inferring half from stationary/laminar alone; radius-line arithmetic mean is not area mean.

records.title: Biforcazioni
records.assumptionsAndDomain: Steady incompressible junction with exactly two outlets, no leakage/storage, fixed12mL/s inflow.
records.manualProcedure: Subtract upper branch from12; sum both outputs to check12.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Domain0..12 keeps both outputs nonnegative; at either endpoint one outlet carries zero.
